en.headline: Firefighters tackle rooftop blaze at Mong Kok building
en.dek: Police said multiple callers reported the fire at Shun King Building on Nelson Street around 5:30pm, with dozens evacuated and no injuries reported.
body: Firefighters were still working on a rooftop fire at Shun King Building on Nelson Street in Mong Kok on Tuesday evening, after police received multiple reports at about 5:30pm.

RTHK reported that stored items on the rooftop were believed to have caught fire, sending flames and thick black smoke into the sky. About several dozen people were evacuated. Fire crews used one hose line and a breathing-apparatus team, taking a hose into the building and also directing water from a neighbouring block.

A large number of fire engines were standing by nearby. Traders at the open-air market downstairs continued business, and onlookers gathered at street level. Police said there were no reports of injuries. The cause had not been confirmed.

zh.headline: 旺角順景大廈天台火警 數十人疏散暫無受傷報告
zh.dek: 警方稱下午約5時半接獲多人報案，指奶路臣街順景大廈天台起火，初步消息指雜物燒着，消防以一喉及煙帽隊灌救。
body: 旺角奶路臣街順景大廈星期二傍晚發生天台火警。警方表示，下午約5時半接獲多人報案。
港台報道，初步消息指天台雜物起火，現場火光熊熊，大量黑煙升上半空，大約數十人疏散。消防出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，拖喉進入大廈，亦從相鄰大廈向起火位置射水。
大批消防車在附近戒備。大廈樓下露天街市的商戶繼續營業，不少市民圍觀。警方說暫時未有人受傷報告，起火原因仍待查。
